title: Windows laptop repair in Bhaktapur
intro: We repair Windows laptops in Bhaktapur: screen, battery, keyboard, RAM and software problems. Bring it to our shop in Sukuldhoka, or we pick it up from your home inside Bhaktapur and bring it back after the repair.
fixes: Battery that drains fast, won't charge, or is swollen
Slow laptop, Windows problems, virus cleanup
how: Message us on WhatsApp with the laptop model and the problem.
Bring the laptop to the shop, or we pick it up from your home inside Bhaktapur.
We check it in person and tell you the price before any work starts.
For expensive parts that have to be ordered, we confirm with you before ordering.
We repair it and hand it back, or drop it back at your home.

questions.question: Can you tell me the price on WhatsApp?
questions.answer: No. We check the laptop in person first, then give you the price. A price given without seeing the laptop is usually wrong, so we don't guess.

questions.question: Do you repair MacBooks?
questions.answer: No. We repair Windows laptops only, not MacBooks, iPads or other tablets.

questions.question: Do you pick up the laptop from my home?
questions.answer: Yes, anywhere inside Bhaktapur. Send your area and the problem to 984-0270440 on WhatsApp.
